Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Only the most grotesque ghouls, bloodthirsty beasts, and famous fiends make it onto the cover of Horrors from Across the Planes—Magic’s only periodical celebrating all the creepiest creeps from across the Multiverse. Give your opponents nightmares as you take these macabre monsters from magazine cover to your gaming table.
Art by Ed Repka
Contents:
• 1x Doom Whisperer
• 1x Ravenous Chupacabra
• 1x Koma, Cosmos Serpent
• 1x Mazirek, Kraul Death Priest
• 1x Uril, the Miststalker
